---
title: "format-links with only `{format, text}` entries"
format:
  html:
    format-links:
      - format: typst
        text: PDF
        icon: file-pdf
      - format: docx
        text: Word
        icon: file-word
  typst: default
  docx: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElementCount:
        selectors:
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a'
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="9606.pdf"]'
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="9606.docx"]'
        counts: [2, 1, 1]
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="9606.docx"]']
        matches: ['^Word$']
---

`format-links` lists every format as a `{format, text, icon}` object and has no plain string entry.
Listing a format this way renames its link: "Other Formats" shows only PDF and Word, not the default Typst and MS Word links as well (#9606).
